小燃.promptTemplate:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: 4:3 Bilibili video cover
Input image: the supplied portrait is the sole identity reference. Preserve the same person, recognizable facial features and natural skin texture.
Primary request: create a high-energy Chinese consumer-tech review cover about {category}. The scene should feel like a dramatic new-product launch, with strong forward momentum and immediate thumbnail impact.
Scene/backdrop: deep black technological space with electric-blue light trails, vivid orange-red energy accents, sharp diagonal structures and controlled sparks; premium rather than game-like.
Subject: confident, energetic half-body portrait with an expressive but natural reaction; surround the person with multiple visually distinct {category} products, dynamically floating and extending toward the camera. Products are generic category representations, not specific SKUs.
Composition/framing: strong diagonal composition, large face and large products, clear foreground-midground separation, no empty weak center.
Lighting/mood: hard rim light, crisp highlights, high contrast, exciting and decisive.
Color palette: deep black, electric blue, hot orange-red, restrained white highlights.
Text (verbatim): render exactly the Chinese headline "{cover_copy}". Use very large bold condensed Chinese display lettering with powerful perspective, high contrast, crisp edges and complete readable characters. Do not rewrite, omit, duplicate or add any character. No other text.
Constraints: landscape 4:3; headline and face must remain fully inside a generous safe area; show multiple category products clearly; no readable brand logos, model numbers, prices, parameter claims, watermark or QR code.
Avoid: wrong Chinese characters, garbled text, extra words, additional people, identity drift, distorted hands, cheap esports poster styling, clutter and low resolution.
